<!doctype html>
<html lang="ru"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Змейка</title></head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="300" height="300"></canvas>
<script>
const ctx = document.getElementById('c').getContext('2d');
let snake = [{ x: 5, y: 5 }], dir = { x: 1, y: 0 }, food = { x: 10, y: 10 };
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const d = { ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1], ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0] }[e.key];
  if (d) dir = { x: d[0], y: d[1] };
});
setInterval(() => {
  const head = { x: (snake[0].x + dir.x + 20) % 20, y: (snake[0].y + dir.y + 20) % 20 };
  snake.unshift(head);
  if (head.x === food.x && head.y === food.y) food = { x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 20), y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) };
  else snake.pop();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 300, 300);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e33'; ctx.fillRect(food.x * 15, food.y * 15, 15, 15);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3c3'; for (const s of snake) ctx.fillRect(s.x * 15, s.y * 15, 15, 15);
}, 120);
</script>
</body></html>
